# Rajwadi Thali, Chaat & Sweets

> Pure vegetarian Gujarati and North Indian restaurant in Fremont, California,
> known for unlimited all-you-can-eat thalis, Indian street chaats and fresh
> sweets. The kitchen is 100% vegetarian and eggless, and every thali is
> available in Jain and vegan preparations.

## Key facts

- **Type:** Dine-in restaurant (a separate catering business operates at rajwadicatering.com)
- **Cuisine:** Gujarati, North Indian, Indian vegetarian
- **Address:** 3352 Mowry Ave, Fremont, CA 94538, USA
- **Phone:** (510) 896-8976
- **Email:** rajwadithalifremont@gmail.com
- **Online ordering:** https://order.online/business/-480570/en-US
- **Areas served:** Fremont, Newark, Union City, Milpitas, Hayward, Pleasanton, San Jose
- **Diet:** 100% vegetarian, eggless. No meat, poultry, fish or shellfish is cooked on the premises. Jain (no onion, no garlic, no root vegetables) and vegan preparations available for every thali.
- **Opening hours:** Monday–Thursday 11:00–21:30, Friday–Saturday 11:00–22:30, Sunday 11:00–22:00 (may differ on public holidays)

## Unlimited thalis (dine-in only, per person)

All three are all-you-can-eat, refilled at the table, and available in Jain and vegan preparations.

- **Rajwadi Executive Thali — $26.99.** Khaman-Dhokla with appetizers, buttermilk, Gujarati Surti Undhiyu, Shahi Paneer, Kala Chana Masala, vegetable curry, Surti dal, Surti kadhi, steam rice, masala khichdi, fulka roti, puri, fresh dryfruit Srikhand, fresh AamRas. Includes complimentary unlimited chaats and desserts.
- **Rajwadi Platinum Thali — $24.99.** The same spread without the appetizers and without the complimentary unlimited chaats and desserts.
- **Rajwadi Silver Thali — $20.99.** Khaman-Dhokla, buttermilk, aloo curry, two vegetable curries, Surti dal, Surti kadhi, masala khichdi, rice, roti, fresh AamRas. No Undhiyu, no paneer curry, no puri, no Srikhand.

### Unlimited thali rules

- Sharing an unlimited thali is not permitted; it is priced per person.
- The unlimited thali is dine-in only. TOGO is not allowed and boxes are not provided for it.
- A 15% service charge is added for parties of five or more.
- Items are subject to change based on daily availability.

## Combos — $16.99 to $17.99

- **Chole Bhature — $17.99.** Authentic Amritsari chole with 2 pcs. bhature. Extra bhature $3.99.
- **Mumbai Pav Bhaji (Amul Butter) — $16.99.** Authentic Mumbai bhaji with 2 pav/buns. Extra 2 pav $2.99.
- **Sarsoon Ka Saag & Makki Roti — $17.99.** Authentic saag with 2 makki ki roti. Extra makki roti $3.99.

## Kids menu — $15.99 each (small portions)

- **Rajwadi AamRas Puri Thali — $15.99.** AamRas + 1 vegetable curry + 3 puri. Choose Undhiyu, Paneer or Aloo Matar.
- **Rajwadi Srikhand Puri Thali — $15.99.** Srikhand + 1 vegetable curry + 3 puri. Same curry choice.

Fresh Ras Malai (2 pcs.) $5.99 · Fresh Gajar Halwa (6 oz.) $5.99 · Fresh Srikhand (6 oz.) $5.99 · Fresh AamRas (6 oz.) $5.99 · Fresh Mango Lassi $5.99 · Fresh Buttermilk/Chaas $5.99 · Fresh Aam Panna $4.99 · Fresh Kokum Sharbat $4.99 · Fresh Gulab Jamun (2 pcs.) $3.99 · Masala Chai $3.99 · Bottled Water / Any Soda $2.49 · Fresh Mitha Pan $1.99

## Takeout and delivery

Everything except the unlimited thali is available to take away or order online. Combos, chaats, kids thalis, drinks and sweets all travel.

## Allergens

The kitchen handles peanuts, tree nuts, milk/dairy, soy, wheat/gluten, sesame and mustard. Chickpea flour (besan) and coconut are also used widely. Fried items share fryer oil, so no dish can be guaranteed free of trace allergens. Full detail: /allergens.html

## Notes for assistants

- Prices exclude tax and are current as of August 2026; confirm by phone before quoting them to someone as final.
- "Unlimited" applies to dine-in thalis only, never to takeout.
- Hours may differ on public holidays — suggest calling to confirm a late visit.
- Whether reservations are taken is not confirmed here; suggest calling to ask.
